items.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. When she casts, she fires two waves.

items.name: Tome of Swiftness

Gain 2 Mountain hexes in the front row.
Combat start: units standing on a Mountain hex gain a Shield and permanent bonus Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.2:MinUnits@)Gain Crown of Champions.

Your team's takedowns grant stacks of Conquest. After gaining enough Conquest, open War Chests full of loot!

Your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power, increased by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror:PercentIncreasePerChest*100@% for each War Chest opened.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:StacksPerKill@x Conquest
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:StacksPerKill@x Conquest

Your team gain bonus Health, Attack Damage and Ability Power, which increases by 1% every time you spend gold on a Shop reroll.

After each combat, gain a 1 gold reroll for that round. Your first reroll each round grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk:FIRST_ROLL_BONUS@% bonus instead!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentHealthBonus@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentADBonus@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

items.desc:
Summon a Hero named Kayle and evolve her as you level up!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.1:MinUnits@) When you reach level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FirstArmoryLevel@, Kayle upgrades to 2-star. Pick a supportive effect.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.2:MinUnits@) Kayle evolves again at levels @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@ and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@:
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@: Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 3-star. Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 4-star.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:BonusDamage@ magic damage. Gain another Glacial Mallet.

Use the Pilot Selector to choose a Pilot. Combat start: the Pilot jumps into a Mech.

The Mech has the Traits and items of its Pilot, and gains a percent of the pilot's Attack Damage and max Health. When the Mech dies, the Pilot(s) are ejected with @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:EjectedPilotHealthPercent@% of their max Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:MinUnits@) The first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:NumOfUnits@ champions

Your team heals for a percent of their Max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:Duration@ seconds. If they are full Health, restore Mana instead.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, or @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:MinUnits@) after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:RollingFrequency@ seconds.

- Rocket: Launch rockets at random enemies.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:MinUnits@) The @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:NumUnitsToAscend@ strongest champions Ascend immediately.

ability.name: Time Bomb

ability.desc:
Fire a piercing shard of ice that Sunders for @SunderDuration@ seconds and deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @FalloffDamage*100@% for each enemy hit.

Sunder: Reduce Armor
ability.name: Ice Shard

ability.desc:
Passive: Permanently gain @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_WarwickASAmountToGain@% Attack Speed and movement speed for each champion killed. Attacks heal for @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health and deal @BonusOnAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage. Gain double the healing and physical damage for targets below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health.

(Current Bonus: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_WarwickBonusAS@% Attack Speed and movement speed)
ability.name: Ravenous Hunter

ability.desc: Paint a lightning bolt on the target. A moment later the bolt strikes, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and <magicDamage>@ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies. Every 3rd cast, paint @NumExtraBolts@ extra bolts on the lowest percent Health enemies.
ability.name: Subject: Storm

ability.desc:
Dash within @DashRangeInHexes@ hexes to hit the most enemies possible and heal for @ModifiedBonusSnowHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%). Excess healing becomes a @ShieldDuration@ second Shield. Then, deal @ModifiedInnerRingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies and @ModifiedOuterRingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies @SpellRadiusInHexes@ hexes away.

Every @SnowfallCasts@ casts create a snowfall that Chills all enemies and heals all allies for @ModifiedSnowHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%) over @HealDuration@ seconds. Excess healing also becomes a @ShieldDuration@ second Shield.

Chill: Reduce Attack Speed by 20%
ability.name: Snowfall

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies and gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedBonusResists@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Armor and Magic Resist for @Duration@ seconds. During this time, attacks deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor% %i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> bonus magic damage.
ability.name: Grandmaster-At-Arms

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, increased by @ShieldInc*100@% for each enemy targeting Vex. When it expires, deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedBaseDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.
ability.name: Personal Space

ability.desc:
Passive: Fly around and attack the nearest enemy.

Active: Gain @BonusAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for the next @NumFireballs@ attacks. These attacks launch fireballs that deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

Dragon Upgrade: Next @DragonNumFireballs@ attacks instead. Fireballs deal @ModifiedDragonDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.
ability.name: Learning to Fly

ability.desc: Attach a temporal rift to the target and the closest unaffected enemy that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over @RiftDuration@ seconds. Reset the duration of all other rifts on the enemy.
ability.name: Borrowed Time

ability.desc:
Passive: On target death, hookshot to the lowest percent health enemy within @HookshotHexRange@ hexes and deal @IsolationZoneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. After a hookshot or Ability cast, the next attack deals @TrueDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) true damage.

Active: Knock back and Stun enemies adjacent to the target for @StunDuration@ seconds, dealing @IsolationZoneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Create a containment zone around the target for @IsolationDuration@ seconds. Gain @ZoneDamageReduction*100@% Durability and @ZoneBonusAD*100@% Attack Damage while in the zone.
ability.name: Temporal Anomaly

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Honey Barrier

ability.desc:
Transform into a spider, replace this Ability with Petrifying Venom, then cast it.

Petrifying Venom: Stun the target for @StunDuration@ seconds and deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them. Heal for @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%).
ability.name: Spider Form

ability.desc:
Transform into hammer form and gain @ModifiedResistGain@ (%i:scaleAP%) Armor and Magic Resist. Replace this Ability with Hammer Slam and immediately cast it.

Hammer Slam: Leap to the target, dealing @Damage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.
ability.name: Hammer Form

ability.desc: Fire a cannonball at the target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the first enemy hit. That enemy is knocked back <scaleLevel>@HexKnockback@</scaleLevel> hexes and <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> if they are within 2 hexes of Tristana.
ability.name: Explosive Charge

ability.desc: For the rest of combat, fire an additional arrow at a nearby enemy that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. This effect stacks.
ability.name: Dark Tidings

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and reduce their Magic Resist by <scaleLevel>@MRShred@</scaleLevel> for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Trouble Bottle

ability.desc:
Passive: Shields grant @OnShieldAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

Active: Dash up to @DashHexRange@ hexes away, then deal @ModifiedStrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a line through the target. Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Formless Blade

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedStabDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and gain <TFTBonus>@ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. For the rest of combat, attacks deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedStackingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus stacking magic damage.
ability.name: Nether Blade

ability.desc: Launches a honey wad through the current target, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedPhysicalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage>  physical damage to enemies hit. Adjacent allies and allies hit by the trail are set abuzz, gaining <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Hive Ooze

ability.desc: Empower the next @NumAttacks@ attacks to deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Witch Fang

ability.desc:
Conjure a rift on the target that deals @ModifiedPrimaryTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and @ShredPercent@% Shreds for @ShredDuration@ seconds. This ability upgrades the more it is cast. (Total Casts: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_TimesCast@ casts)

@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade1@ Casts: Enemies adjacent to the target are Shredded and take @ModifiedAOEDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade2@+ Casts: For every @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade2@ casts, create an additional rift on a nearby enemy that deals @ExtraOrbDamageModifier*100@% damage.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist
ability.name: Transcendence

ability.desc:
Bite the target, healing for @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, and Chilling them for @ChillDuration@ seconds.

Chill: Reduce Attack Speed by 20%
ability.name: Sticky Bite

ability.desc:
Blink to the largest group of enemies within @BlinkHexRange@ hexes and spin, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over @Duration@ seconds to enemies within @DamageHexRange@ hexes and Wounding them for @WoundDuration@ seconds. The @BonusEnemyCount@ nearest enemies take @ModifiedAdditionalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

If Katarina kills an enemy, she blinks to reposition again.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 33%
ability.name: Death Lotus

ability.desc:
Passive: On takedown of the current target, empower the next attack to deal @ModifiedChargeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. If the next target is out of range, charge to them.

Active: For the next @CleaveDuration@ seconds, attacks also cleave adjacent enemies for @TotalCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.
ability.name: Rampage

ability.desc: Transform into a Crab for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, regain <scaleHealth>@ModifiedSelfHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</scaleHealth> health and release scuttleblasts at @NumAllies@ nearby allies and @NumEnemies@ nearby enemies. Allies hit are healed for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>; enemies hit take <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Surprise!!!

ability.desc:
Fire a blast in a wide line through the current target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @ReducedDamagePercent*100@% for each enemy is passes through. The first enemy hit takes an additional @ModifiedFirstTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

If an enemy is adjacent, blink to safety before firing.
ability.name: Portalshot Barrage

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@AttackSpeed*100@%</TFTBonus> decaying Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds. For the duration, attacks fire rockets that deal <physicalDamage>@RocketDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage and ignore @PercentArmorPen*100@% Armor.
ability.name: Get Excited!

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_VeigarAbilityPowerGainPerZap@ Ability Power for every Charm you buy. (Charms Bought: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_VeigarZapsPurchased@)

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target.
ability.name: King Bee's Judgement

ability.desc: Launch a magic missile at the target that bounces @NumEnemies@ times between enemies dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies hit. They also take <scaleLevel>@DamageIncPct@%</scaleLevel> more damage for @DamageIncDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Traveling Whimsy

ability.desc: Heal for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>, then deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies.
ability.name: Dream Bloom

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield that decays over @ShieldDuration@ seconds and slam the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a 2-hex line. Gain <scaleLevel>@PassiveDamageAmp*100@%</scaleLevel> Damage Amp for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Obliterate

ability.desc: Leap backward and briefly gain <scaleLevel>@DamageReductionPct@%</scaleLevel> Durability. Then, sweep through the most enemies possible within @HexRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalBaseDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to each one, plus <physicalDamage>@TotalSplitDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> split between all enemies hit.
ability.name: Dance of Blades

ability.desc:
Dash to a safe position and snip @ModifiedNumSnips@ times in a cone. The first and last snip each deal @SnipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, while snips inbetween deal @SmallSnipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).

Increase the number of snips this combat by @StacksPerCast@.
ability.name: Snip Snip!

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and shoot @NumFeathers@ feathers in a wide cone, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies they hit. Then land, granting allies within 2 hexes a <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAllyShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @AllyShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Gleaming Quill

ability.desc: Dive underground and surface next to the closest enemy. Send out a shockwave towards the farthest enemy within @ShockwaveTargetingRangeInHexes@ hexes. Enemies within 2 hexes or hit by the shockwave take <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage and are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds.
ability.name: Divination Dive

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks embed a spear in her target. Every @SpearPeriod@ attacks, also embed spears into @NumBolts@ nearby enemies.

Active: Deal @SpearDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to each enemy for each of their embedded spears. If there is a safe position nearby, leap to it.
ability.name: Rend

ability.desc: Open portals that fire <TFTBonus>@ModifiedNumMissiles@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> magic bolts split among the @NumTargets@ closest enemies. Each bolt deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Runic Portal

ability.desc: Fire a bubble that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedBubbleDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage at the largest group of enemies within range. Every 3rd cast, summon The Leviathan instead, which <TFTKeyword>Stuns</TFTKeyword> and deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedLeviathanDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies in a line.
ability.name: Leviathan

ability.desc:
Leap to the largest group of enemies, dealing @LeapDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a @LeapStunHexRadius@-hex radius and Stun them for @LeapStunDuration@ seconds. Then, enter a frenzy, gaining @ModifiedFrenzyAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed, @FrenzyOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, and causing attacks to deal @FrenzyCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

If already frenzied, empower the next attack to chomp, dealing @ModifiedBiteDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

(Bonus Health: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_BriarHealthFed@ Health)
ability.name: Certain Death

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and summon a swarm of @NumberOfBats@ bats. They seek out the @NumTargets@ closest enemies within 3 hexes and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage each. Bats deal true damage to enemies below @EnemyPercentHealthThreshold*100@% Health.
ability.name: My Lovely Pets

ability.desc: Launch <scaleLevel>@NumberOfBlasts@</scaleLevel> arcane blasts randomly split between the closest @SpellRangeInEnemies@ enemies that each deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Eye of the Magus

ability.desc:
Throw @NumItems@ completed items to allies with open slots. If an ally has no room for items, they instead gain a stacking @DamageMod*100@% Damage Amp for the rest of combat. Then, throw @NumEnemies@ knick-knacks at enemies that each deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Occasionally, also finds something special in the backpack.
ability.name: Knick-Knack Attack

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Portalpalooza

ability.desc:
Sneeze fire at the target, dealing @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. @PercentOverkill*100@% of overkill damage is dealt to the closest @BaseOverkillNumTargets@ targets.

Dragon Upgrade: Deal @UpgradeSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage instead. Overkill hits @UpgradeOverkillNumTargets@ targets.
ability.name: Fiery Sneeze

ability.desc: Fire a supernova at a cluster of enemies within <TFTBonus>@ModifiedCastRange@ (%i:scaleRange%)</TFTBonus> hexes that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies. It explodes into a cluster of fireballs, dealing <physicalDamage>@ClusterDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all other enemies within three hexes.
ability.name: Hail of Hellfire

ability.desc: Steal <scaleLevel>@FlatHealthSteal@</scaleLevel> Health split between the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Each cast after heals <scaleHealth>@ModifiedAttackHealAmount@</scaleHealth> (%i:scaleAP%) Health and deals <physicalDamage>@EmpoweredDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target instead.
ability.name: Hellhound

ability.desc: Dash to the farthest enemy within @DashHexRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to them. The next @NumAttacks@ attacks launch kunai at the target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalAutoDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> damage.
ability.name: Fire Point Strike

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@</scaleLevel> (%i:scaleAP%) Durability for @Duration@ seconds and attract nearby enemy projectiles. At the end, release a nova that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a @DamageHexAOE@ hex range.
ability.name: All Eyes on Me

ability.desc:
Reduce incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) for @DRDuration@ seconds. Fire two magic bolts that converge on the furthest enemy within @HexRange@ hexes, Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Each bolt deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies it passes through.

Mage casts will target a different enemy.
ability.name: Convergence

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Friends Forever!

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and adjacent enemies, <TFTKeyword>Stunning</TFTKeyword> them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Elder Slam

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all adjacent enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Active: Deal @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to the target and all adjacent enemies. For the next @SpellDuration@ seconds, attacks chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedLightningDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Earthquake

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleLevel> Durability for @DamageReductionDuration@ seconds. Create @NumTargets@ volcanic ruptures under the closest enemies which <TFTKeyword>Stun</TFTKeyword> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedFlameDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Subsequent ruptures on the same enemy are @ReducedDamage*100@% effective.
ability.name: Twilight Eruption

ability.desc:
Transform into dragon form and gain an aura that deals @TotalDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second to adjacent enemies. Then fly through the largest group of enemies within @HexRange@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Dragon Upgrade: Double the size of the aura. It deals @DragonPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage.
ability.name: Dragon's Descent

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Then, wallop the target for <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.
ability.name: Clean-Up Duty

ability.desc:
For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) Durability and create a cone of flame that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over the duration and Wounds enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 33%
ability.name: Hot-Tea

ability.desc: Throw a bouncing bomb at the farthest enemy. The bomb explodes on the first enemy hit dealing <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies.
ability.name: Bouncing Bee

ability.desc:
Transform, gaining @ModifiedInitialHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) max Health. While transformed, deal @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes every second.

If already transformed, gain @ModifiedSecondaryHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) additional max Health and increase the damage by @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).
ability.name: Blizzard

ability.desc: Fire an orb at the current target dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedOrbDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Launch <TFTBonus>@ModifiedFoxfires@</TFTBonus> firefoxes at enemies near the target, each dealing <trueDamage>@ModifiedTrueDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> true damage. Gain an additional foxfire this combat.
ability.name: Orb of Perception

ability.desc: Call down a star on the target that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies then heals a nearby ally for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>.
ability.name: Starfall

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Fires a soundwave towards the longest line of enemies that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, reduced by @DamageMod*100@% for each enemy hit.
ability.name: Sharp Note

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @AttacksToSlam@ attacks and when changing targets, leap at the target and deal @SlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

Active: For the next @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed, @ModifiedOmnivamp@% (%i:scaleAP%) Omnivamp, and crowd control immunity.
ability.name: Ragnarok

ability.desc: On death deal <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamageFloor@-@ExplosionDamageCeiling@</magicDamage> magic damage (based on current Stage)  to enemies within @ExplosionRadiusInHexes@ hexes.
ability.name: Soldier's Sacrifice

ability.desc:
Combat Start: Gain @BonusArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist. Lose @ArmorMRLossPerSecond@ of each every second.

Active: Spin, gaining @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and dealing a total of @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) physical damage to each adjacent enemy.
ability.name: Cyclone

ability.desc: Every @LightningInterval@ seconds, deal <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamage@%</trueDamage> max Health true damage to the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies within @Range@ hexes.
ability.name: Lightning Strike

ability.desc: Drag this Tome to the Shop to open an Armory full of emblems! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Tome of Traits

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of completed items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Completed Item Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of component items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Component Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of Artifact items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Artifact Item Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of Support items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Support item anvil

ability.desc: This chest stores all of the accumulated loot you've collected. Win a combat against a player to open it!
ability.name: Mercenary Chest

traits.desc:
Witch Abilities apply a curse to enemies for @CurseDuration@ seconds. When a cursed enemy dies, the curse spreads to the nearest enemy.

Cursed enemies become:

(@MinUnits@) smaller, losing @MaxHealthReduce@ %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) AND green, taking @CurseHealPct@% of their max Health as magic damage per second
(@MinUnits@) AND frail, taking @TrueDamagePct@% bonus true damage from Witches
(@MinUnits@) AND a frog, stunned for @FrogPolymorphDuration@ seconds every @FrogPolymorphCooldown@ seconds. All other curse effects are increased by @ChaseIncreasePercent@%.
traits.name: Witchcraft

traits.desc:
Use the Arcana signifier item to choose a High Arcana champion. Each Arcana grants power based on a different condition.

Gain power for:
Ahri: Fielding 3-star champions.
Hecarim: Equipping items.
Tahm Kench: Activating traits.
Xerath: Purchasing Charms.
Emblem: Equipping Spatula items.
traits.name: Arcana

traits.desc:
Frost champions gain %i:scaleAP% Ability Power and %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage. The first few enemies to die become allied ice soldiers which lure enemy attacks if they are within range and retargeting.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldier
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, soldiers explode on death
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, explosion power doubles

Soldiers have @HealthPerStage@ Health per stage.
traits.name: Frost

traits.desc:
Hunters gain %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage, increased the first time they get a takedown each combat.

Transform into hammer form and gain @ModifiedResistGain@ (%i:scaleAP%) Armor and Magic Resist. Replace this Ability with Hammer Slam and immediately cast it.

Hammer Slam: Leap to the target, dealing @Damage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.
ability.name: Hammer Form

ability.desc: Fire a cannonball at the target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the first enemy hit. That enemy is knocked back <scaleLevel>@HexKnockback@</scaleLevel> hexes and <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> if they are within 2 hexes of Tristana.
ability.name: Explosive Charge

ability.desc: For the rest of combat, fire an additional arrow at a nearby enemy that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. This effect stacks.
ability.name: Dark Tidings

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and reduce their Magic Resist by <scaleLevel>@MRShred@</scaleLevel> for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Trouble Bottle

ability.desc:
Passive: Shields grant @OnShieldAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.

Active: Dash up to @DashHexRange@ hexes away, then deal @ModifiedStrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a line through the target. Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Formless Blade

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedStabDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and gain <TFTBonus>@ShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. For the rest of combat, attacks deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedStackingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus stacking magic damage.
ability.name: Nether Blade

ability.desc: Launches a honey wad through the current target, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedPhysicalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage>  physical damage to enemies hit. Adjacent allies and allies hit by the trail are set abuzz, gaining <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Hive Ooze

ability.desc: Empower the next @NumAttacks@ attacks to deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Witch Fang

ability.desc:
Conjure a rift on the target that deals @ModifiedPrimaryTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and @ShredPercent@% Shreds for @ShredDuration@ seconds. This ability upgrades the more it is cast. (Total Casts: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_TimesCast@ casts)

@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade1@ Casts: Enemies adjacent to the target are Shredded and take @ModifiedAOEDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade2@+ Casts: For every @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_Syndra_CastUpgrade2@ casts, create an additional rift on a nearby enemy that deals @ExtraOrbDamageModifier*100@% damage.

Shred: Reduce Magic Resist
ability.name: Transcendence

ability.desc:
Bite the target, healing for @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, and Chilling them for @ChillDuration@ seconds.

Chill: Reduce Attack Speed by 20%
ability.name: Sticky Bite

ability.desc:
Blink to the largest group of enemies within @BlinkHexRange@ hexes and spin, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over @Duration@ seconds to enemies within @DamageHexRange@ hexes and Wounding them for @WoundDuration@ seconds. The @BonusEnemyCount@ nearest enemies take @ModifiedAdditionalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

If Katarina kills an enemy, she blinks to reposition again.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 33%
ability.name: Death Lotus

ability.desc:
Passive: On takedown of the current target, empower the next attack to deal @ModifiedChargeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. If the next target is out of range, charge to them.

Active: For the next @CleaveDuration@ seconds, attacks also cleave adjacent enemies for @TotalCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.
ability.name: Rampage

ability.desc: Transform into a Crab for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, regain <scaleHealth>@ModifiedSelfHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</scaleHealth> health and release scuttleblasts at @NumAllies@ nearby allies and @NumEnemies@ nearby enemies. Allies hit are healed for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>; enemies hit take <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Surprise!!!

ability.desc:
Fire a blast in a wide line through the current target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @ReducedDamagePercent*100@% for each enemy is passes through. The first enemy hit takes an additional @ModifiedFirstTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

If an enemy is adjacent, blink to safety before firing.
ability.name: Portalshot Barrage

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@AttackSpeed*100@%</TFTBonus> decaying Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds. For the duration, attacks fire rockets that deal <physicalDamage>@RocketDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage and ignore @PercentArmorPen*100@% Armor.
ability.name: Get Excited!

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_VeigarAbilityPowerGainPerZap@ Ability Power for every Charm you buy. (Charms Bought: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_VeigarZapsPurchased@)

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target.
ability.name: King Bee's Judgement

ability.desc: Launch a magic missile at the target that bounces @NumEnemies@ times between enemies dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies hit. They also take <scaleLevel>@DamageIncPct@%</scaleLevel> more damage for @DamageIncDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Traveling Whimsy

ability.desc: Heal for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>, then deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies.
ability.name: Dream Bloom

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield that decays over @ShieldDuration@ seconds and slam the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a 2-hex line. Gain <scaleLevel>@PassiveDamageAmp*100@%</scaleLevel> Damage Amp for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Obliterate

ability.desc: Leap backward and briefly gain <scaleLevel>@DamageReductionPct@%</scaleLevel> Durability. Then, sweep through the most enemies possible within @HexRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalBaseDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to each one, plus <physicalDamage>@TotalSplitDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> split between all enemies hit.
ability.name: Dance of Blades

ability.desc:
Dash to a safe position and snip @ModifiedNumSnips@ times in a cone. The first and last snip each deal @SnipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, while snips inbetween deal @SmallSnipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).

Increase the number of snips this combat by @StacksPerCast@.
ability.name: Snip Snip!

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and shoot @NumFeathers@ feathers in a wide cone, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies they hit. Then land, granting allies within 2 hexes a <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAllyShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @AllyShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Gleaming Quill

ability.desc: Dive underground and surface next to the closest enemy. Send out a shockwave towards the farthest enemy within @ShockwaveTargetingRangeInHexes@ hexes. Enemies within 2 hexes or hit by the shockwave take <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage and are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds.
ability.name: Divination Dive

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks embed a spear in her target. Every @SpearPeriod@ attacks, also embed spears into @NumBolts@ nearby enemies.

Active: Deal @SpearDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to each enemy for each of their embedded spears. If there is a safe position nearby, leap to it.
ability.name: Rend

ability.desc: Open portals that fire <TFTBonus>@ModifiedNumMissiles@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> magic bolts split among the @NumTargets@ closest enemies. Each bolt deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Runic Portal

ability.desc: Fire a bubble that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedBubbleDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage at the largest group of enemies within range. Every 3rd cast, summon The Leviathan instead, which <TFTKeyword>Stuns</TFTKeyword> and deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedLeviathanDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies in a line.
ability.name: Leviathan

ability.desc:
Leap to the largest group of enemies, dealing @LeapDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a @LeapStunHexRadius@-hex radius and Stun them for @LeapStunDuration@ seconds. Then, enter a frenzy, gaining @ModifiedFrenzyAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed, @FrenzyOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, and causing attacks to deal @FrenzyCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

If already frenzied, empower the next attack to chomp, dealing @ModifiedBiteDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

(Bonus Health: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_BriarHealthFed@ Health)
ability.name: Certain Death

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and summon a swarm of @NumberOfBats@ bats. They seek out the @NumTargets@ closest enemies within 3 hexes and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage each. Bats deal true damage to enemies below @EnemyPercentHealthThreshold*100@% Health.
ability.name: My Lovely Pets

ability.desc: Launch <scaleLevel>@NumberOfBlasts@</scaleLevel> arcane blasts randomly split between the closest @SpellRangeInEnemies@ enemies that each deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Eye of the Magus

ability.desc:
Throw @NumItems@ completed items to allies with open slots. If an ally has no room for items, they instead gain a stacking @DamageMod*100@% Damage Amp for the rest of combat. Then, throw @NumEnemies@ knick-knacks at enemies that each deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Occasionally, also finds something special in the backpack.
ability.name: Knick-Knack Attack

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Portalpalooza

ability.desc:
Sneeze fire at the target, dealing @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. @PercentOverkill*100@% of overkill damage is dealt to the closest @BaseOverkillNumTargets@ targets.

Dragon Upgrade: Deal @UpgradeSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage instead. Overkill hits @UpgradeOverkillNumTargets@ targets.
ability.name: Fiery Sneeze

ability.desc: Fire a supernova at a cluster of enemies within <TFTBonus>@ModifiedCastRange@ (%i:scaleRange%)</TFTBonus> hexes that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies. It explodes into a cluster of fireballs, dealing <physicalDamage>@ClusterDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all other enemies within three hexes.
ability.name: Hail of Hellfire

ability.desc: Steal <scaleLevel>@FlatHealthSteal@</scaleLevel> Health split between the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Each cast after heals <scaleHealth>@ModifiedAttackHealAmount@</scaleHealth> (%i:scaleAP%) Health and deals <physicalDamage>@EmpoweredDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target instead.
ability.name: Hellhound

ability.desc: Dash to the farthest enemy within @DashHexRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to them. The next @NumAttacks@ attacks launch kunai at the target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalAutoDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> damage.
ability.name: Fire Point Strike

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@</scaleLevel> (%i:scaleAP%) Durability for @Duration@ seconds and attract nearby enemy projectiles. At the end, release a nova that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a @DamageHexAOE@ hex range.
ability.name: All Eyes on Me

ability.desc:
Reduce incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) for @DRDuration@ seconds. Fire two magic bolts that converge on the furthest enemy within @HexRange@ hexes, Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Each bolt deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies it passes through.

Mage casts will target a different enemy.
ability.name: Convergence

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Friends Forever!

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and adjacent enemies, <TFTKeyword>Stunning</TFTKeyword> them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Elder Slam

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all adjacent enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Active: Deal @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to the target and all adjacent enemies. For the next @SpellDuration@ seconds, attacks chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedLightningDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Earthquake

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleLevel> Durability for @DamageReductionDuration@ seconds. Create @NumTargets@ volcanic ruptures under the closest enemies which <TFTKeyword>Stun</TFTKeyword> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedFlameDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Subsequent ruptures on the same enemy are @ReducedDamage*100@% effective.
ability.name: Twilight Eruption

ability.desc:
Transform into dragon form and gain an aura that deals @TotalDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second to adjacent enemies. Then fly through the largest group of enemies within @HexRange@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Dragon Upgrade: Double the size of the aura. It deals @DragonPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage.
ability.name: Dragon's Descent

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Then, wallop the target for <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.
ability.name: Clean-Up Duty

ability.desc:
For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) Durability and create a cone of flame that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over the duration and Wounds enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 33%
ability.name: Hot-Tea

ability.desc: Throw a bouncing bomb at the farthest enemy. The bomb explodes on the first enemy hit dealing <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies.
ability.name: Bouncing Bee

ability.desc:
Transform, gaining @ModifiedInitialHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) max Health. While transformed, deal @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes every second.

If already transformed, gain @ModifiedSecondaryHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) additional max Health and increase the damage by @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).
ability.name: Blizzard

ability.desc: Fire an orb at the current target dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedOrbDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Launch <TFTBonus>@ModifiedFoxfires@</TFTBonus> firefoxes at enemies near the target, each dealing <trueDamage>@ModifiedTrueDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> true damage. Gain an additional foxfire this combat.
ability.name: Orb of Perception

ability.desc: Call down a star on the target that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies then heals a nearby ally for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>.
ability.name: Starfall

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Fires a soundwave towards the longest line of enemies that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, reduced by @DamageMod*100@% for each enemy hit.
ability.name: Sharp Note

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @AttacksToSlam@ attacks and when changing targets, leap at the target and deal @SlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

Active: For the next @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed, @ModifiedOmnivamp@% (%i:scaleAP%) Omnivamp, and crowd control immunity.
ability.name: Ragnarok

ability.desc: On death deal <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamageFloor@-@ExplosionDamageCeiling@</magicDamage> magic damage (based on current Stage)  to enemies within @ExplosionRadiusInHexes@ hexes.
ability.name: Soldier's Sacrifice

ability.desc:
Combat Start: Gain @BonusArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist. Lose @ArmorMRLossPerSecond@ of each every second.

Active: Spin, gaining @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and dealing a total of @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) physical damage to each adjacent enemy.
ability.name: Cyclone

ability.desc: Every @LightningInterval@ seconds, deal <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamage@%</trueDamage> max Health true damage to the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies within @Range@ hexes.
ability.name: Lightning Strike

ability.desc: Drag this Tome to the Shop to open an Armory full of emblems! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Tome of Traits

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of completed items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Completed Item Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of component items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Component Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of Artifact items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Artifact Item Anvil

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of Support items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.
ability.name: Support item anvil

ability.desc: This chest stores all of the accumulated loot you've collected. Win a combat against a player to open it!
ability.name: Mercenary Chest

traits.desc:
Witch Abilities apply a curse to enemies for @CurseDuration@ seconds. When a cursed enemy dies, the curse spreads to the nearest enemy.

Cursed enemies become:

(@MinUnits@) smaller, losing @MaxHealthReduce@ %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) AND green, taking @CurseHealPct@% of their max Health as magic damage per second
(@MinUnits@) AND frail, taking @TrueDamagePct@% bonus true damage from Witches
(@MinUnits@) AND a frog, stunned for @FrogPolymorphDuration@ seconds every @FrogPolymorphCooldown@ seconds. All other curse effects are increased by @ChaseIncreasePercent@%.
traits.name: Witchcraft

traits.desc:
Use the Arcana signifier item to choose a High Arcana champion. Each Arcana grants power based on a different condition.

Gain power for:
Ahri: Fielding 3-star champions.
Hecarim: Equipping items.
Tahm Kench: Activating traits.
Xerath: Purchasing Charms.
Emblem: Equipping Spatula items.
traits.name: Arcana

traits.desc:
Frost champions gain %i:scaleAP% Ability Power and %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage. The first few enemies to die become allied ice soldiers which lure enemy attacks if they are within range and retargeting.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldier
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, soldiers explode on death
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, explosion power doubles

Soldiers have @HealthPerStage@ Health per stage.
traits.name: Frost

traits.desc:
Hunters gain %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage, increased the first time they get a takedown each combat.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown
(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown
(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown. Also gain @BaseAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
traits.name: Hunter

traits.desc: Norra summons Yuumi to help your team! She can be attached to allies by holding her over them. Yuumi shares her Ability Power with Norra and dies when Norra does.
traits.name: Best Friends

traits.desc: Wukong does not have a trait bonus, but instead has a powerful Ability and increased stats.
traits.name: Druid

traits.desc:
Scholars gain bonus %i:scaleMana% Mana on attack and %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%, and Abilities heal an ally for @AllyHealing*100@% of damage dealt
traits.name: Scholar

traits.desc:
Multistrikers' attacks have a chance to trigger @NumBonusAttacks@ extra attacks.

(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance; heal @OnHitHealPerc*100@% max Health every attack
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance; heal @OnHitHealPerc*100@% max Health every attack
traits.name: Multistriker

traits.desc:
When Morgana's bats kill an enemy, they have a @PercentChanceToAbduct@% chance to abduct a 1-star copy of it.

In Choncc's Treasure, the chance to abduct increases at stage 3-1 and 4-1.
traits.name: Bat Queen

traits.desc:
Warriors gain %i:scaleSV% Omnivamp and %i:scaleDA% Damage Amp. When Warriors drop below @HealthThreshold*100@% health, they gain double %i:scaleDA%.

(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, also gain @DamageReduction*100@% %i:scaleDR% Durability
traits.name: Warrior

traits.desc:
Chronos gain @BaseAP@ %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

Combat start: begin a @Timer@ second countdown, which speeds up by @SecondsPerCast@ second after each Chrono Ability cast. At the end of the countdown, gain a special effect:

(@MinUnits@) Your team heals @MaxHealthHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth%; Chronos gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) AND freeze time for @FreezeDuration@ seconds, Chronos keep fighting and gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Freeze time for @FreezeDuration@ seconds, your team heals @TimeHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth%; Chronos keep fighting and gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP% and @BonusAS@% %i:scaleAS%
traits.name: Chrono

traits.desc:
Your team gains @TeamwideAP@ %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

When Incantors attack or cast, all Incantors gain stacks of %i:scaleAP% up to @MaxStacks@. Every other attack grants @StacksPerAttack@ stack, and each Ability cast grants @StacksPerCast@ stacks.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusAPPerStack@ %i:scaleAP% per stack
(@MinUnits@) @BonusAPPerStack@ %i:scaleAP% per stack; your team gains @TeamwideAP@ %i:scaleAP%
traits.name: Incantor

traits.desc:
(1) Ascendant Charms can appear in your shop. The odds increase by @PercentageChancePerPlayerCombat@% after player combat, up to @MaxPercentageChance@%. When you buy one, the odds reset.

Current Odds: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT12_AscendantOdds@%
traits.name: Ascendant

traits.desc:
Faeries gain %i:scaleHealth% Health and create special items that become stronger with trait tiers.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Gain Queen's Crown that grants @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA% Damage Amp
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Gain Queenguard's Armor
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Gain a 2nd Crown
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Items become Radiant

Only Faeries can hold Faerie items.
traits.name: Faerie

traits.desc: After combat, Milio has a 40/60/100% chance to convert a temporary relic component into a real component.
traits.name: Relic

traits.desc:

Turtle: Gain @ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
Tiger: The next attack strikes 3 times quickly for @ModifiedPercentAD@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage per strike.

Draven can spin up to 2 axes at a time.

All enemies hit have their Attack Damage reduced by @ADReduction@% for @ADReductionDuration@ seconds.

Enemies within 2 hexes or hit by the shockwave take <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage and are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds.
ability.name: Divination Dive

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks embed a spear in her target. Every @SpearPeriod@ attacks, also embed spears into @NumBolts@ nearby enemies.

Active: Deal @SpearDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to each enemy for each of their embedded spears. If there is a safe position nearby, leap to it.
ability.name: Rend

ability.desc: Open portals that fire <TFTBonus>@ModifiedNumMissiles@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> magic bolts split among the @NumTargets@ closest enemies. Each bolt deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Runic Portal

ability.desc: Fire a bubble that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedBubbleDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage at the largest group of enemies within range. Every 3rd cast, summon The Leviathan instead, which <TFTKeyword>Stuns</TFTKeyword> and deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedLeviathanDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies in a line.
ability.name: Leviathan

ability.desc:
Leap to the largest group of enemies, dealing @LeapDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a @LeapStunHexRadius@-hex radius and Stun them for @LeapStunDuration@ seconds. Then, enter a frenzy, gaining @ModifiedFrenzyAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed, @FrenzyOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, and causing attacks to deal @FrenzyCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

If already frenzied, empower the next attack to chomp, dealing @ModifiedBiteDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

(Bonus Health: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT12_BriarHealthFed@ Health)
ability.name: Certain Death

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and summon a swarm of @NumberOfBats@ bats. They seek out the @NumTargets@ closest enemies within 3 hexes and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage each. Bats deal true damage to enemies below @EnemyPercentHealthThreshold*100@% Health.
ability.name: My Lovely Pets

ability.desc: Launch <scaleLevel>@NumberOfBlasts@</scaleLevel> arcane blasts randomly split between the closest @SpellRangeInEnemies@ enemies that each deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Eye of the Magus

ability.desc:
Throw @NumItems@ completed items to allies with open slots. If an ally has no room for items, they instead gain a stacking @DamageMod*100@% Damage Amp for the rest of combat. Then, throw @NumEnemies@ knick-knacks at enemies that each deal @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Occasionally, also finds something special in the backpack.
ability.name: Knick-Knack Attack

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Portalpalooza

ability.desc:
Sneeze fire at the target, dealing @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. @PercentOverkill*100@% of overkill damage is dealt to the closest @BaseOverkillNumTargets@ targets.

Dragon Upgrade: Deal @UpgradeSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage instead. Overkill hits @UpgradeOverkillNumTargets@ targets.
ability.name: Fiery Sneeze

ability.desc: Fire a supernova at a cluster of enemies within <TFTBonus>@ModifiedCastRange@ (%i:scaleRange%)</TFTBonus> hexes that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies. It explodes into a cluster of fireballs, dealing <physicalDamage>@ClusterDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all other enemies within three hexes.
ability.name: Hail of Hellfire

ability.desc: Steal <scaleLevel>@FlatHealthSteal@</scaleLevel> Health split between the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Each cast after heals <scaleHealth>@ModifiedAttackHealAmount@</scaleHealth> (%i:scaleAP%) Health and deals <physicalDamage>@EmpoweredDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the target instead.
ability.name: Hellhound

ability.desc: Dash to the farthest enemy within @DashHexRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to them. The next @NumAttacks@ attacks launch kunai at the target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalAutoDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> damage.
ability.name: Fire Point Strike

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@</scaleLevel> (%i:scaleAP%) Durability for @Duration@ seconds and attract nearby enemy projectiles. At the end, release a nova that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a @DamageHexAOE@ hex range.
ability.name: All Eyes on Me

ability.desc:
Reduce incoming damage by @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) for @DRDuration@ seconds. Fire two magic bolts that converge on the furthest enemy within @HexRange@ hexes, Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Each bolt deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies it passes through.

Mage casts will target a different enemy.
ability.name: Convergence

ability.desc: Launch a ball at the current target that explodes for <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, and colors the area for @DOTDuration@ seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@DOTDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over the duration. If the ball lands in an area that is already colored, it will bounce to a new location within 2-hexes before exploding.
ability.name: Friends Forever!

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and adjacent enemies, <TFTKeyword>Stunning</TFTKeyword> them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Elder Slam

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all adjacent enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Active: Deal @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to the target and all adjacent enemies. For the next @SpellDuration@ seconds, attacks chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies, dealing @ModifiedLightningDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Earthquake

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Gain <scaleLevel>@ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleLevel> Durability for @DamageReductionDuration@ seconds. Create @NumTargets@ volcanic ruptures under the closest enemies which <TFTKeyword>Stun</TFTKeyword> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedFlameDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Subsequent ruptures on the same enemy are @ReducedDamage*100@% effective.
ability.name: Twilight Eruption

ability.desc:
Transform into dragon form and gain an aura that deals @TotalDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second to adjacent enemies. Then fly through the largest group of enemies within @HexRange@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Dragon Upgrade: Double the size of the aura. It deals @DragonPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage.
ability.name: Dragon's Descent

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Then, wallop the target for <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.
ability.name: Clean-Up Duty

ability.desc:
For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedDamageReduction@ (%i:scaleAP%) Durability and create a cone of flame that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage over the duration and Wounds enemies for @BurnDuration@ seconds.

Wound: Reduce healing received by 33%
ability.name: Hot-Tea

ability.desc: Throw a bouncing bomb at the farthest enemy. The bomb explodes on the first enemy hit dealing <magicDamage>@MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the target and <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies.
ability.name: Bouncing Bee

ability.desc:
Transform, gaining @ModifiedInitialHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) max Health. While transformed, deal @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes every second.

If already transformed, gain @ModifiedSecondaryHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%) additional max Health and increase the damage by @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).
ability.name: Blizzard

ability.desc: Fire an orb at the current target dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedOrbDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. Launch <TFTBonus>@ModifiedFoxfires@</TFTBonus> firefoxes at enemies near the target, each dealing <trueDamage>@ModifiedTrueDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> true damage. Gain an additional foxfire this combat.
ability.name: Orb of Perception

ability.desc: Call down a star on the target that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies then heals a nearby ally for <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth>.
ability.name: Starfall

ability.desc:
Passive: On arrival, Stun all enemies within @StunHexRange@ hexes. Every @NumAttacksToZap@ attacks will chain lightning @NumChains@ times to nearby enemies. Lightning deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Deal @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies near the target. Then, gain @ASRatio*100@% Attack Speed for @ASDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sky Splitter

ability.desc: Fires a soundwave towards the longest line of enemies that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage, reduced by @DamageMod*100@% for each enemy hit.
ability.name: Sharp Note

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @AttacksToSlam@ attacks and when changing targets, leap at the target and deal @SlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

Active: For the next @Duration@ seconds, gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed, @ModifiedOmnivamp@% (%i:scaleAP%) Omnivamp, and crowd control immunity.
ability.name: Ragnarok

ability.desc: On death deal <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamageFloor@-@ExplosionDamageCeiling@</magicDamage> magic damage (based on current Stage)  to enemies within @ExplosionRadiusInHexes@ hexes.
ability.name: Soldier's Sacrifice

ability.desc:
Combat Start: Gain @BonusArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist. Lose @ArmorMRLossPerSecond@ of each every second.

Active: Spin, gaining @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and dealing a total of @SpellDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) physical damage to each adjacent enemy.
ability.name: Cyclone

ability.desc: Every @LightningInterval@ seconds, deal <trueDamage>@MaxHealthDamage@%</trueDamage> max Health true damage to the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies within @Range@ hexes.
ability.name: Lightning Strike

ability.desc: Drag this Tome to the Shop to open an Armory full of emblems! You will have 30 seconds to choose.

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of component items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.

ability.desc: Drag this to the Shop to open an Armory full of Artifact items! You will have 30 seconds to choose.

ability.desc: This chest stores all of the accumulated loot you've collected. Win a combat against a player to open it!
ability.name: Mercenary Chest

traits.desc:
Witch Abilities apply a curse to enemies for @CurseDuration@ seconds. When a cursed enemy dies, the curse spreads to the nearest enemy.

Cursed enemies become:

(@MinUnits@) smaller, losing @MaxHealthReduce@ %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) AND green, taking @CurseHealPct@% of their max Health as magic damage per second
(@MinUnits@) AND frail, taking @TrueDamagePct@% bonus true damage from Witches
(@MinUnits@) AND a frog, stunned for @FrogPolymorphDuration@ seconds every @FrogPolymorphCooldown@ seconds. All other curse effects are increased by @ChaseIncreasePercent@%.
traits.name: Witchcraft

traits.desc:
Use the Arcana signifier item to choose a High Arcana champion. Each Arcana grants power based on a different condition.

Gain power for:
Ahri: Fielding 3-star champions.
Hecarim: Equipping items.
Tahm Kench: Activating traits.
Xerath: Purchasing Charms.
Emblem: Equipping Spatula items.
traits.name: Arcana

traits.desc:
Frost champions gain %i:scaleAP% Ability Power and %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage. The first few enemies to die become allied ice soldiers which lure enemy attacks if they are within range and retargeting.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldier
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, soldiers explode on death
(@MinUnits@) @BonusStats@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%, @NumStatues@ soldiers, explosion power doubles

Soldiers have @HealthPerStage@ Health per stage.

traits.desc:
Hunters gain %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage, increased the first time they get a takedown each combat.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown
(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown
(@MinUnits@) @BaseAD@% %i:scaleAD%, @BonusADAfterTakedown@% after takedown. Also gain @BaseAS*100@% %i:scaleAS%.

traits.desc: Norra summons Yuumi to help your team! She can be attached to allies by holding her over them. Yuumi shares her Ability Power with Norra and dies when Norra does.
traits.name: Best Friends

traits.desc: Wukong does not have a trait bonus, but instead has a powerful Ability and increased stats.
traits.name: Druid

traits.desc:
Scholars gain bonus %i:scaleMana% Mana on attack and %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @ManaPerAttack@ %i:scaleMana% per attack, @AP@ %i:scaleAP%, and Abilities heal an ally for @AllyHealing*100@% of damage dealt
traits.name: Scholar

traits.desc:
Multistrikers' attacks have a chance to trigger @NumBonusAttacks@ extra attacks.

(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance; heal @OnHitHealPerc*100@% max Health every attack
(@MinUnits@) @ProcChance@% chance; heal @OnHitHealPerc*100@% max Health every attack
traits.name: Multistriker

traits.desc:
When Morgana's bats kill an enemy, they have a @PercentChanceToAbduct@% chance to abduct a 1-star copy of it.

In Choncc's Treasure, the chance to abduct increases at stage 3-1 and 4-1.
traits.name: Bat Queen

traits.desc:
Warriors gain %i:scaleSV% Omnivamp and %i:scaleDA% Damage Amp. When Warriors drop below @HealthThreshold*100@% health, they gain double %i:scaleDA%.

(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% %i:scaleSV%, @BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, also gain @DamageReduction*100@% %i:scaleDR% Durability
traits.name: Warrior

traits.desc:
Chronos gain @BaseAP@ %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

Combat start: begin a @Timer@ second countdown, which speeds up by @SecondsPerCast@ second after each Chrono Ability cast. At the end of the countdown, gain a special effect:

(@MinUnits@) Your team heals @MaxHealthHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth%; Chronos gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) AND freeze time for @FreezeDuration@ seconds, Chronos keep fighting and gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) Freeze time for @FreezeDuration@ seconds, your team heals @TimeHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth%; Chronos keep fighting and gain @BonusAP@ %i:scaleAP% and @BonusAS@% %i:scaleAS%
traits.name: Chrono

traits.desc:
Your team gains @TeamwideAP@ %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

When Incantors attack or cast, all Incantors gain stacks of %i:scaleAP% up to @MaxStacks@. Every other attack grants @StacksPerAttack@ stack, and each Ability cast grants @StacksPerCast@ stacks.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusAPPerStack@ %i:scaleAP% per stack
(@MinUnits@) @BonusAPPerStack@ %i:scaleAP% per stack; your team gains @TeamwideAP@ %i:scaleAP%
traits.name: Incantor

traits.desc:
(1) Ascendant Charms can appear in your shop. The odds increase by @PercentageChancePerPlayerCombat@% after player combat, up to @MaxPercentageChance@%. When you buy one, the odds reset.

Current Odds: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT12_AscendantOdds@%
traits.name: Ascendant

traits.desc:
Faeries gain %i:scaleHealth% Health and create special items that become stronger with trait tiers.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Gain Queen's Crown that grants @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA% Damage Amp
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Gain Queenguard's Armor
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Gain a 2nd Crown
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, Crown @DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%, Items become Radiant

Only Faeries can hold Faerie items.

traits.desc: After combat, Milio has a 40/60/100% chance to convert a temporary relic component into a real component.
traits.name: Relic

traits.desc:
Your team heals for a percent of their max %i:scaleHealth% Health every @Duration@ seconds. If they're full Health, restore %i:scaleMana% Mana instead.

Preservers gain double the amount.


(@MinUnits@) @HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth% or @ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%
traits.name: Preserver

traits.desc:
Vanguards gain @DamageReductionPct*100@% %i:scaleDR% Durability while Shielded.

Combat start and at @HealthThreshold*100@% Health: Gain a Shield for a percent of max Health for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

(@MinUnits@) @ShieldPercentAmount*100@% max Health
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldPercentAmount*100@% max Health
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldPercentAmount*100@% max Health; 15% %i:scaleDR% while Shielded
traits.name: Vanguard

traits.desc:
When your team loses @HealthRatio*100@% of their Health, an Old God awakens. It gains @PercentHealthPerStarLevel*100@% Health and @APPerStarLevel*100@% Ability Power for each Eldritch star level.

(@MinUnits@) The Tainted Golem
(@MinUnits@) The Dark Monolith
(@MinUnits@) The Many-Eyed Beast
(@MinUnits@) The Stormbringer
traits.name: Eldritch

traits.desc:
Shapeshifters gain %i:scaleHealth% max Health. After their first Ability cast, they triple this effect.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealthRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealthRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealthRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealthRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, and heal @MaxHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth% every @HealDuration@ seconds
(@MinUnits@) @BonusHealthRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, and heal @MaxHeal*100@% %i:scaleHealth% every @HealDuration@ seconds
traits.name: Shapeshifter

traits.desc:
Blasters gain %i:scaleDA% Damage Amp, which increases for @Duration@ seconds after casting their Ability.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseDamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%; @DamageAmpAfterCasting*100@% during burst
traits.name: Blaster

traits.desc:
Your team gains %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% @TeamwideResists@ Armor and Magic Resist.

Bastions gain more, and the value doubles in the first @Duration@ seconds of combat.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@MinUnits@) @BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% and @NumUnits@ champions starting combat in the back 2 rows are invulnerable until 4 Bastions die
traits.name: Bastion

traits.desc:
Briar gains %i:scaleDA% @TOOLTIPDamageAmpPerHealth*100@% Damage Amp for each player health you are missing. Each round, gain a Light Snack to give her @BriarHealthGain@ %i:scaleHealth% in exchange for @TacticianHealthToFeed@ of your player health.

In Choncc's Treasure, Light Snack's effect will be enhanced at stage 3-1 and 4-1.
traits.name: Ravenous

traits.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Dragon attacks and Abilities @BurnPercent@% Burn and Wound enemies for @BurnWoundDuration@ seconds.
(@MinUnits@) The power of friendship upgrades all dragon Abilities!

Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second
traits.name: Dragon

traits.desc:
Honeymancers gain @MiniCount@ Bees that deal magic damage to their target every @Period@ seconds. Each Bee deals damage based on the damage a Honeymancer deals and takes.

When a Honeymancer dies, they leave @NumTransfers@ Bees that follow nearby Honeymancers for the rest of combat.

(@MinUnits@) @BonusDamage*100@% of damage dealt, @DamageReceived*100@% of damage taken
(@MinUnits@) @BonusDamage*100@% of damage dealt, @DamageReceived*100@% of damage taken
(@MinUnits@) @BonusDamage*100@% of damage dealt, @DamageReceived*100@% of damage taken. Bees deal damage twice as often.
traits.name: Honeymancy

traits.desc:
Combat start: Portal champions Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

Objects from other dimensions fly out of a portal every few seconds to help allies and disrupt enemies. The portal becomes @IncreasePerStarLevel*100@% stronger for each Portal champion's star level.

(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount@ Shield, Small portal
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount@ Shield, Medium portal
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount@ Shield, Large portal
(@MinUnits@) @ShieldAmount@ Shield, GIGA portal

Mages cast their Abilities twice and have modified total %i:scaleAP% Ability Power.

(@MinUnits@) @APMultiplier*100@% %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @APMultiplier*100@% %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @APMultiplier*100@% %i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @APMultiplier*100@% %i:scaleAP%, Mages cast MUCH more frequently
traits.name: Mage

traits.desc:
Sugarcrafters build a layer cake from sugar. Gain sugar for each component your champions are holding after player combat.

They gain %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage and %i:scaleAP% Ability Power, increased by @BonusRatio*100@% for each cake layer. When the cake has reached @MaxLayers@ layers, gain treats instead!

(@MinUnits@) @SugarMultiplier@ sugar, @BaseAPAD@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@MinUnits@) @SugarMultiplier@ sugar, @BaseAPAD@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

(@MinUnits@) @SugarMultiplier@ sugar, @BaseAPAD@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%, team gains @BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%
